acceptance_gate.condition: g3_now_mechanically_enforced == true AND pytest_passed == true AND current_paper_lint_clean == true AND conductor_unmodified_assert == true
acceptance_gate.principle: G3 is mechanically defended only when the standalone lint exists, its test is green, the current paper passes it, and the conductor is untouched.

field_principles.current_paper_lint_clean: BARE bool. True iff the current paper targets pass the new lint (G3 currently passes). STORE AS BARE true/false.
field_principles.forbidden_phrasings_count: How many forbidden phrasings + retracted numbers the lint checks -- coverage of the CLAUDE.md narrowing table.
field_principles.g3_now_mechanically_enforced: BARE bool. True iff a standalone lint now defends G3 (was honor-discipline + inline scan). STORE AS BARE true/false.
field_principles.inference_substrate: aggregation_from_upstream_artifacts (principle: a static text lint; no live inference; no compute-bound marker).
field_principles.lint_script_path: scripts/paper_v6_narrowing_lint.py -- the shipped mechanical G3 enforcer.
field_principles.precommit_hook_stanza: The recommended .pre-commit-config.yaml stanza for OPERATOR action -- not auto-wired (operator-curated config).
field_principles.pytest_passed: True iff the parametrized lint test (clean-passes / forbidden-fails / retracted-number-fails) is green.

inference_substrate: aggregation_from_upstream_artifacts (principle: a static text lint; no live inference; no compute-bound marker).
operator_action_note: OPERATOR-ACTION: Review and add precommit_hook_stanza to .pre-commit-config.yaml when operator-curated commit policy approves it.
precommit_hook_stanza:
- repo: local
  hooks:
    - id: paper-v6-narrowing-lint
      name: Paper-v6 narrowing lint
      entry: python scripts/paper_v6_narrowing_lint.py
      language: system
      files: ^(docs/arxiv-paper/main\.tex|docs/technical-report\.md|results/paper_v6_.*\.json)$
